bricks.description: STYLE: a mid-century retro-futuristic gouache and tempera magazine illustration on slightly matte paper: bold heroic diagonal geometry, visible dry opaque brushstrokes over clean underdrawing, warm ochre, cobalt blue, vermilion and slate-green mineral pigments, subtle offset halftone registration and paper tooth. No modern glossy digital painting, no anime lineart, no neon cyberpunk.
bricks.when: For space, the future as it was imagined, hope.

bricks.description: STYLE: a Soviet-era record sleeve design: flat two- or three-colour screen-printed shapes, simple bold geometry and a stylised figure, slight ink misregistration on matte card. Avoid gradients, photorealism, or modern vector gloss.
bricks.when: For a song that should feel like an old LP.

bricks.description: STYLE: a 1960s book-illustration linocut in two colours: carved black lines and one warm flat colour, lyrical simplified figures and landscapes, paper texture showing through. Avoid shading gradients, photographs, or digital effects.
bricks.when: A lyrical story, a childhood, a village.

bricks.description: STYLE: a frame of a Soviet children’s filmstrip: soft gouache illustration with gentle colours faded by projection light, a slightly soft focus, a rounded-corner frame and a faint caption band below. Avoid modern crispness, neon, or 3D.
bricks.when: Childhood memory, a fairy tale, nostalgia.

bricks.description: STYLE: a modernist technical etching: fine cross-hatched lines bitten into copper, precise architectural and scientific forms, crisp black ink on warm paper with a soft plate tone. Avoid colour, painterly brushwork, or digital lines.
bricks.when: Science, a research institute, cold reason.

bricks.description: STYLE: an 1980s Soviet souvenir enamel badge: glossy coloured enamel fields inside thin gold metal outlines, a tiny emblem of a city or mountain, slight metallic shine and stamped relief. Avoid realism, gradients outside the enamel, or plastic CGI.
bricks.when: For a trip, a city, a kitsch memory.
